claim: The Core Insight §: 'a single grain is a snippet … with no discernible pitch … stack thousands … and suddenly you have color' — stability lives in the population; and Population-Level Parameters §: 'an evenly spread crowd locks like a switch; a lumpy one … arrives softly'.

pieces.what: crowd-size ladder: 1, 10, 100, 1000 neurons, heard in turn with the stability measure plotted; tests where the timbre becomes stable (also answers the open question on minimum population)

pieces.section: The Raster Plot as Pedagogical Tool
pieces.what: raster explorer: turn K and watch scatter become vertical stripes while hearing it; tests the stripes/scatter reading
lumpiness attack: switch-like vs soft arrival at the lock, heard and traced
pieces.walks_up_from: an evenly spread crowd at the lock edge

pieces.what: pacemaker ladder and surge-before-lock; tests 'just under the lock, pacemakers make the crowd surge'
